name: funes-api
description: Runtime-agnostic Hono spine over the funes op-registry (S5). The daemon (and later the Astro surface) host this app; all funes deps are INJECTED (dispatch/toolDefs/consoleHtml), so this package imports only hono — no PGLite, no node:fs, no Bun.* — keeping the HTTP contract one source of truth across hosts.
